dialog.english:
��������Is this... the Village of
Beginnings?
We're back!

Hey, the village is back to
normal!

Whoa, there's so many DigiEggs
everywhere!
Hey, wait for me!

Now all the dead Digimon can be
reborn...
Thank goodness...

And so ends the prophecy inscribed
in the ancient ruins...

First, what returned was the
island, and that island created a
new sky and sea and land...
So what does that mean?

In other words, the Digimon world
is being recreated.

Shall we take a photo to
commemorate the occasion,
everyone?
A picture? Why not?
Good idea!
I agree!
Talk to me whenever you are ready!
Okay!
Then I shall take the picture.
Please do!
Ready, guys?
Say cheese!
Aaaaah!
What happened?
It hatched!
How cute!
So you're leaving, no matter what?

I'm proud to be a Virus-type,
y'know! Vaccine and Data-types
like y'all make my stomach turn!
All right, see ya!
...He left.
He's just trying to look cool...
Oh, how nostalgic!

This is where we spent our first
night in this world!

Man, a lot's happened since we
came here, but I'm really glad we
did.

We won't have any regrets going
home!
Joe...

Oh. Oh, no. I shouldn't have said
that...
Hey...
What?

We still have quite a bit of
summer break left...

I think I'll stay here for the
rest of it.
Oh, good idea!
I'll stay here if Matt does!
Me, too! Is that okay, Tai?
Yeah!
I'd like to do so as well.
Me, too!
Me, too! We've got tons of time!

Indeed. If one day here is
equivalent to one second in our
world...

I can do it in my head! Uh... Four
thousand and thirty-two days. So
about a hundred and ten years!
Seriously?!

That's great! We can go on another
adventure!
Yeah!

All right, let's go! Our new
adventure starts now!
...Huh?
It's a solar eclipse...

Children, I've got some news for
you about that eclipse.
Good news or bad news?
...Probably bad news.

But it's just a solar eclipse,
isn't it?

The eclipse's shadow is the gate
to your world.

The eclipse will end in around two
hours.

Then why don't we just wait for
the next gate?

Yeah! After all, we've got a
hundred and ten years left of
summer break!

But that was because of
Apocalymon...

Now, the flow of time in your
world and our world is the same.
What?!
So what happens if we stay?
Matt...

This world may consider you
foreign objects and delete your
data.
So...
Unfortunately...

When you get back, take care of
your mom.

Yeah... And besides, I need to
thank you, Piyomon...

My mom and I were having a hard
time seeing eye-to-eye, but I
think we'll fix it because of you.

I think we'll be able to get along
fine from now on.
Really?
Really!

I'm so happy to hear that, Sora! I
was worried that maybe I was
always bothering you...

Of course not! Not at all!
Piyomon...
Piyomon...

Okay, we might not have
necessarily been the best fighting
duo, but...
...It was still pretty fun.

I think so too! And by the way,
good luck on your studies when you
get home.
Yeah?
What?
Let's shake hands.
Huh? ...Okay, why not.
...huh!
What?
So you *do* have hands!
Tentomon...
Izzy...
I... am... truly thankful to you.
Oi, oi, oi!

You're always bein' so formal and
polite with me, Izzy, even
now...

S-Sorry. But then what should I
say at a time like this?

Well, it's hard to say, but... you
shouldn't be forcin' yourself.

No problem bein' all formal if
that's the way you wanna say it.

Well, the words'll come easy to
you someday.
Do you think so? I hope so...
Waaaaaaah! Waaaaaaaah!
Waaaaaaaah... Don't cry, T.K...

Waaaaaaah... But... But... we
won't be able to see each other
again...

That's not true...
Your world and my world run
on the same time...
...so we'll meet again sometime!
Really?

That's how it was with Devimon,
right?

Yeah, I really believed we'd meet
again...
So believe again!

Okay! We'll meet again. It's a
promise!
Yeah!
...Hey, Matt...
...Yeah?

Can you play your harmonica for me
again?
...Sure.
...Sure.
...Are you serious, Matt?!
What's wrong?
...No, it's nothing.

Hey, this was where I lit a fire
with my Llama Bebé, isn't it?

Yeah! Matt got mad because it
scorched his clothes.
...Huh? Was it my fault?

Wait, no, it's because I was
teasing Gabumon. Hahaha!
Taiiiiii!
Ahaha... ah... *sob*
Haha... *sob*
...Are you sure?
Yeah.
...Thanks.
Looks good on you.

Really? Okay so... take care,
Kari.
Until next time.
Next time?
Next time.
Palmon! Palmooooooon!
Whatcha doin', ribbit?

I can't find Palmon. Have you seen
her?
We haven't, ribbit.

Really? Where did Palmon go... We
don't have much time left...

We've completed modifications to
the trolley. We're ready to go at 
any time.
Okay! Good job!

Come talk to me when you're done
saying your farewells.
Got it, old man!
Indeed!

Have you finished saying your
farewells? We've finished on our
end.
Well...
Can't we have a little more time?

No can do. The gate won't be
waiting.
But...
What's wrong?
Palmon's gone.

Palmon... Stupid, stupid, stupid
Palmon...
Mimi...
Ah! There you are, ribbit!

Mimi's been looking for you,
ribbit.
I know... I don't want to see her.
Why not, ribbit?

If I see her, it's going to hurt
even more when she leaves! So it's
better if we don't...

Are you sure you're okay with
that, ribbit?
Are you *really* sure, ribbit?

You're not gonna regret it,
ribbit?

We're out of time. Please board
the trolley.
All right, guys. Take care!
You too, Tai!
Goodbye!
Goodbye!
Goodbye!
Goodbye!
Goodbye!
Goodbye!
Goodbye!
Mimi!
Mimi!
Yeah!
Mimi! I'm sorry!

It's fine! Thank you, Palmon!
Goodbye!
Mimi! Ack!
Ah!

And for all eight of them, that
was the end of their summer
vacation...

However, the gate would not stay
closed forever.

Nor would this be the first - or
last - of the Chosen Children's
adventures.

The gate to the Digimon world
will surely open again...

And as long as you do not forget
the Digimon, if you wish for it,
then within your heart...
Or, perhaps...
Sure! Take a commemorative photo.
Just a bit longer, please.

We're ready to take the
commemorative photo at any time. 
Are you done talking to everyone?

Understood! Then I shall call
everyone here.

Whenever you're ready, come speak
to me.

This village is gonna be full of
babies when these eggs hatch!
I bet!
You're gonna be busy!

With this many eggs? No doubt
about it!

All right, I'm gonna have to get
down to work!

Which one of these eggs is
Leomon's? Nah, there's no way I 
can recognize it.

Isn't it a little early to be
worrying about that?

He gets lonely if Leomon's not
around.
S-Shut up!

Which one of these eggs is
Leomon's...

So what are you gonna do now,
Centarumon?

I will return to the ruins and
watch over this world's
reconstruction...

so that peace may return to File
Island and the surrounding
continents.

We're the ones who brought that
peaceful world back, aren't we...

Yes, it was thanks to you. You are
welcome to visit at any time.
Yeah! We'll drop by for sure!

I'm truly thankful for everything
you've done for us.

Hey, old man Gennai! What's with
the huge frown?

It's been a while since I've taken
a picture. I'm practicing my
smile!

Wait, what? You look like you're
really mad.

Old man Gennai's got a scary
smile...
Really now? Oh ho ho.

It's been a while since I've taken
a picture. Oh ho ho...

You don't have any lingering
regrets, do you?
We're ready.
Give us a bit more time...

All right. Bring everyone here,
then.

When you're done saying your
farewells, come talk to me.
Hey, Matt!
Oh hey, it's Tai!

This place is always packed.
What's going on today?

Oh, there's a band coming from
overseas. They're having a
concert.

Wait, so you're going to a
concert?

Yeah, I've been a fan for a while.
I'm thinking of picking up the
bass, too.
Really? Do you have a band yet?
No, I'm still working on that...

Yeah... you're pretty bad at
dealing with other people.
Tai, are you insulting me?

You know, we never managed to
settle the score for real when we
were in the Digital World!
Okay, wanna go? With what?
Soccer? Cooking? Karaoke?

There's probably more important
stuff than just that...

You really don't get it, do you?
Nah, forget about it.

Hey! Why are you talking to
yourself all of a sudden?

Oh, quiet down. I gotta go, so see
you later.
Yeah! Have fun at the concert!

I have no idea what Matt was
going on about...
Tai!
Hey, Sora! What's up?

Taking care of some errands. What
about you?

Forget me! Are you seriously
quitting soccer?

Sorry, I thought I might try out
some other stuff, like tennis.

Tennis? That doesn't suit you at
all! Come back to soccer!

It's fine! I'm trying to change my
image. Like maybe taking off the
hat and trying on skirts...

Think maybe it'd be better if I
didn't? Would that suit me better?

Does it really matter? This way,
that way, they're both fine,
aren't they?

Ugh, it was stupid to think you'd
have anything useful to say... I'm
going home.

Hey, Sora! Why'd you get angry all
of a sudden? I don't get it!
Hey, Izzy!
Hello, Tai!

You haven't been coming over
lately. Did something happen?

I've been looking into some things
related to the Vamdemon incident.

Seems like it's had an effect on
both the Digital World and the
real world.
So you can't come over?

Well, I could, but... I've been
stuck to my computer more than I
was before.

You're looking into the Digital
World, right?

Yes. The battle with Apocalymon
had a great impact on the world...

People all over the world have
begun to look into that incident.
And you're one of them, right?

Yes, although of course I've kept
our adventure a secret.

Right now, I'm enjoying myself
exchanging emails with people all
over the world.

Huh! I didn't think you'd say
that, Izzy!
Please don't make fun of me!

I mean, when we were at camp, you
had this really bad expression on
your face whenever we went to bed.
Yes, you might be right.
Right?

I think I simply felt a sense of
distance from everyone.
So that's all it was.
Ah! I've received another email!

Well, if something happens in the
Digital World, tell me as soon as
you can.
Of course!
Mimi!
Tai!

Wow, someone's carrying a lot. Did
you go shopping?

I bought all the clothes that I've
wanted since we got back! And
more!

I know, but you gotta draw the
line somewhere...
I haven't hit that line yet!

Well, today's clothes are lookin'
good today, princess!
Hey, don't call me "princess"!

...Hey, you seem to be doing just
fine.

You know... we had a lot of fun,
but a lot of really sad things
happened too...

I kept getting upset because of 
all the bad things that happened 
to the Digimon who fought for us.
Yeah...

I guess I'm becoming more like an
adult, huh?

I remember you were always saying
stuff along the lines of "I'm
hungry!"
Hey, don't say that!

Papa and Mama are calling me! See
you later, Tai!
Yeah, see you later!
Tai!
Joe! Coming back from cram school?

Man, my grades have been going
down ever since we got back from
the Digital World...

Dad scolded me to death and Mom
started crying. It's been bad.

That's the life of a student who
lives his life by exams, I
guess...
Well, it hasn't been that bad.
Huh?!

Maybe I've built some tolerance in 
the Digital World. I don't faint 
at the sight of blood anymore.

At least, not unless I were losing
blood from anemia.

Hey, you're making progress!
You'll be a great doctor, Joe.

We've all changed a lot ever since
we got back from the Digital
World!

I thought I hadn't, so I was
really surprised.

Hey, whaddya mean by that? Of
course you're changed.
You think so? In what way?

You're a lot more reliable than
you were before!
Yeah, yeah!

Looks like I'll really have to
treat you like my senior!
Right, Mr. Kido?
Hey, Tai! Don't make fun of me!
Sorry, sorry!

Oops! We've been talking for too
long. I don't wanna keep my tutor
waiting!
Wait, you're *still* studying?
See you later!
Joe! Good luck with your studies!
Hey, T.K!
Tai! Long time no see!
Are you visiting Matt's place?

Yeah! Mom's gonna be late at work,
so I'm gonna be eating dinner with
Matt and Dad!

Huh! Do you go to Matt's place
often?
No, not really!

Huh, that's surprising. So
Matt's okay with not seeing you
as much anymore...

That's not it, Tai! I'm grown
up now!

Hahaha! So Matt's not the one
who's grown up, it's you!

I thought I'd be lonely after
leaving Patamon...
But I'm okay now!

So what caused the change of
heart?

Our hearts are connected, even if
we're reaaaaaaaally far apart!

It's the same for me and Matt
and my dad!

Yeah. That's how I feel about
Agumon, too...

Ah! Matt's gonna be waiting for
me! I gotta go!
Yeah! Take care of Matt!
You take care of Kari, too!
What are you looking at, Tai?

Our memorial picture! The one we
took with everyone! The old man
sent it to me by email.
It's been a while.

It all started when you and I met
a Koromon in Karigaoka...
You're right.

Hey, how come you remembered that
and I forgot?

So you've finally realized! I'm
actually psychic!
Hahaha... Very funny...

But honestly, I'm sure the gate to
the Digital World will open again.
Really?

Yeah! And until then, I'm going to
be training my body!

Oh! We got an email! Who's it
from?
H-Hey! Stop it! Don't look!

It's from Sora, isn't it? I know
you two exchanged email addresses!

Kari! Have you been peeking at
my computer?

I have no idea what you're talking
about!
Hey! You just wait right there!

Hey, Gabumon. Say goodbye to
Tai.

Yeah... hey, Tai, when you get
back, don't forget about us!
Of course I won't!

And I'm sorry for pretending to
take off your pelt!

Aw... you don't have to apologize
for that, Tai!

Really? Then next time, why don't
you show me what you look like
under there?
Hey, Tai!
Pffffhahaha!
We'll meet again, right?

Thanks for all the times you
helped us, Tai!

I could say the same! Take care,
Piyomon!

Okay! And make sure you're getting
along with Sora.

Haha! You sounded like her mom
there just now.

Although you sound like a kid
whenever you go looking for her.
He's right!
Ahaha...
And take care of Sora's mom, too.
Take care o' yourself, Tai!
You too, Tentomon!

Thanks for teaching us all kinds
of stuff about the Digital World!

Whaddya mean by that? All I do is
just study stuff.

If we had a school 'ere, I'd love
to go to one.

S-School... That just brought up a
whole ton of bad memories...

Be sure to work hard when you get
back!
Aha...
You can do it, Tai!

Guess I can't just secretly sneak
into your world, eh?
Huh? Mimi? Where's Palmon?

I've been looking for her, but I
can't find her...

What?! Then we gotta go look for
her!
But Tai, you need to go soon!
It's okay, Tai.
Mimi...
Palmon...
Mimi...

Huh! I thought you'd be crying all
over the place, but you seem to be
doing okay.
Of course! I've gotten stronger.
Right?

Yeah... You did a great job
against Piemon!

Yeah! T.K and I have been
training hard, so there was no way
he could have won!

I'll have to make sure you two
don't beat me to it, either!
Oh, Tai!
Ahahaha!

Maybe I could go meet T.K if I
evolved...

Are you done saying your goodbyes
to Joe?
Yeah, I guess!

You don't really seem that worried
about Joe...

Well, yeah! I don't really have to
worry!

Joe's the kind of guy who'll pull
things off somehow!
G-Gomamon!

Although it's hard to get him to
do anything unless you motivate
him.
Hey!

Haha! You two are like a comedy
duo.

We'll meet again someday! So don't
forget to bring Joe with you!
Sure!
Not you too, Tai...
Take care of Joe, okay?

I won't be seeing you anymore, I
suppose.

Yeah. We didn't get to spend much
time together, but thanks.

I'm the one who should be thanking
you. Thanks for believing me, even
when I was your enemy.
Well, Kari believed in you, too.

You kept your promise. You said
you'd protect me...

Yeah. You're a really important
friend to us, Tailmon.
...Thanks, Tai.

I have a lot of friends now, so I
don't need to worry anymore.
